about_the_game:
Discover ☵ HIRAETH - A gripping sci-fi survival experience where you awaken on the forsaken planet Ahra Prime. Navigate through its harsh, diverse landscapes filled with secrets and dangers.

Gameplay Modes:

ETERNAL Mode

Dive into an endless survival sandbox where your skills are your only ally. Survive, explore, and uncover lore that deepens with each playthrough.

REVELATIONS Mode

Embark on a narrative-driven journey, uncovering the mysteries of Ahra Prime guided by the enigmatic Charon.

Key Features:

Hand-Crafted Open World

Scour the planet for resources, facing environmental hazards and predators. Every journey is a test of survival.

Deep Survival Mechanics

Manage hunger, hydration, health, and equipment durability in a system tailored for both novice and seasoned survivors.

Crafting & Upgrades

Master crafting to create essential gear and upgrade your EVA suit for better survival odds.

Progressive Skills & Perks

Earn skills and perks that enhance your abilities, making each survival attempt more strategic.

Companions

Choose between a quirky alien slug or a high-tech droid to assist in your adventures.

For New Players:

Training Course: A dedicated center to learn the ropes, ensuring everyone can grasp the game's unique mechanics.

Audio Experience:

Atmospheric Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the desolation of Ahra Prime with an electronic score that complements the game's mood.

Why ☵ HIRAETH?

Whether you're a lone wolf tackling the planet's perils head-on or a strategist avoiding conflict, ☵ HIRAETH offers freedom in survival. With every playthrough unique due to randomization and player choices, your saga on Ahra Prime will be as unpredictable as the planet itself.

Remember, on Ahra Prime, 

"wise men speak, and fools decide."

Which will you be?

WHY SINGLE PLAYER?

Advantages Of Single Player Games Over Multiplayer:

✅ Engaging Storyline: Single player games often offer deeper and more complex narratives that can provide emotional experiences.

✅ No Dependency on Others: You don't have to wait for other players or worry about their skills or behavior. The game progresses at your own pace.

✅ Full Control: You have complete control over the gameplay, allowing you to explore the game's world and uncover its secrets at your own pace.

✅ No Connection Issues: No need for a stable internet connection, meaning you can play anytime, anywhere.

✅ Personalized Experience: Single player games often offer greater opportunities for personalization and individual approaches to gameplay.

✅ Achievements and Challenges: Focus on individual achievements and challenges, which can be satisfying to accomplish.

✅ Peace and Quiet: No risk of harassment or toxic behavior from other players.

✅ Slower Aging of the Game: Single player games age more slowly, as players are willing to return to them even after many years. Multiplayer games typically have a shorter lifespan, dependent on community activity.

WHY HIRAETH STANDS OUT

Many survival games follow a familiar formula: chop trees, build structures, craft, and survive. Hiraeth breaks this mold by offering a unique and immersive survival experience that keeps the fun and flow intact.

✅ Innovative Survival Mechanics:

  • Eat, Drink, Rest, Heal, Recharge, Manage Oxygen.

  • Always monitor your EVA Suit's air supply.

  • Manage and maintain gear and health.

✅ Four Difficulty Levels:

  • Wayfarer: Easy, focus on story.

  • Drifter: Normal, balanced challenge.

  • Outcast: Hard, for veterans.

  • Void Rider: Nightmare, extreme challenge.

✅ Player Freedom:

  • Multiple playstyles: aggressive or strategic.

  • Randomization, accessibility options, rougelite elements.

  • Unique gameplay each session.

✅ Accessibility and Elegance:

  • Adjustable parental settings.

  • Designed for diverse skill levels.

  • Avoids unnecessary gore.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 with latest updates (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible graphics card (Recommended: GTX 1050 Ti / Radeon RX 560 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 70 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Stereo output required.
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for smoother map loading

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 with latest updates (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X, Intel i5-10600K
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA: GeForce RTX 2080 or higher (DLSS supported) | AMD: Radeon RX 6800 XT or higher (FSR support coming soon)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 70 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Stereo output required, Surround capabilities
  • Additional Notes: SSD

short_description: HIRAETH is a sci-fi, first-person survival game set on a desolate, alien planet. Adapt to various threats while discovering the secrets of the abandoned, dystopian colony. You can choose between two distinct game modes that share common gameplay mechanics - sandbox and story.
